title: Lao PDR, Vietnam prime ministers arrive in PH for 49th ASEAN Summit
summary: Lao People's Democratic Republic Prime Minister Saleumxay Kommasith and Vietnamese Prime Minister Lê Minh Hưng arrived in the Philippines on Saturday, November 14, for the 49th ASEAN Summit and…

blocks.text: Lao People's Democratic Republic Prime Minister Saleumxay Kommasith and Vietnamese Prime Minister Lê Minh Hung (Courtesy: ASEAN National Organizing Council)

Lao People's Democratic Republic Prime Minister Saleumxay Kommasith and Vietnamese Prime Minister Lê Minh Hưng arrived in the Philippines on Saturday, November 14, for the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits.
Upon his arrival at the airport, Lê Minh Hưng was welcomed by Pasay City Mayor Imelda Calixto-Rubiano.
Both prime ministers were also received and escorted by Cabinet Secretary Benhur Abalos.
ASEAN leaders began arriving in the Philippines, the host of this year's summit, on November 14, according to the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA).
The summit is scheduled to take place from November 16 to 18, with the opening ceremony set for November 15. —VBL, GMA News
